# Theresa Frische — Systemic & Integrative Counsellor

> Online, international counselling practice for individuals and couples navigating change, transition, burnout, and life across borders. Sessions are offered in English and German. This is a counselling (Beratung) practice — not psychotherapy, medical treatment, diagnosis, or a substitute for any of these.

Website: https://theresafrische.com — German mirror: https://theresafrische.com/de/
Contact: theresafrische@gmail.com

## Who Theresa Frische is

Theresa Frische is a Systemic & Integrative Counsellor offering online counselling to individuals and couples internationally. She holds an M.Sc. in Clinical Psychology and is a trained Somatic Experiencing practitioner, with advanced systemic training, and has over eight years of experience supporting individuals and organisations through meaningful change. Her own life has spanned different countries, long-distance and intercultural relationships, and adapting to new cultural and professional environments — experience that informs her work with people in transition.

## What the practice offers

- Individual counselling: one-to-one online sessions (60 minutes), in English or German. A confidential, steady space to slow down and make sense of what is happening in your life, drawing on systemic, somatic, parts-based, and mindfulness-informed approaches.
- Couples counselling: online sessions for couples (60–120 minutes). Support for understanding patterns of disconnection, improving communication, and rebuilding closeness. Not only for relationships in crisis.
- Weekly Wellbeing Community: a calm weekly online group for mindfulness, stress reduction, and community connection. Tuesdays 20:30–21:30, online via Teams, in English. No prior experience needed.
- For organisations: keynote talks (30–60 min), workshops and seminars (2–4 hours), in-depth trainings (1–3 days), structured 8-week wellbeing programmes, and confidential employee and leadership counselling. Delivered online or on-site in Germany and Switzerland.

## Format, languages, and logistics

- Format: online (video), worldwide. Organisational work can be online or on-site in Germany and Switzerland.
- Languages: English and German.
- Availability: by appointment. Scheduling with international clients across time zones is arranged individually (based in Central European Time).
- Fees: sessions are self-pay and are not reimbursed by statutory or private health insurance (Krankenkasse). No pricing is published; fees are discussed in the discovery call. No diagnosis or referral is needed.

## Who it is for

High-functioning, cross-cultural internationals, expats, and couples navigating change, transition, relocation, burnout, overwhelm, relationship strain, questions of identity and direction, and life across countries and cultures. Many people reach out not because something has broken, but because something has shifted and familiar ways of coping no longer feel sufficient.

## Approach

Integrative and context-oriented, drawing on complementary perspectives rather than a single fixed method:

- Systemic counselling: exploring relational and contextual patterns and how they shape experience.
- Somatic awareness (Somatic Experiencing): attending to the body's responses to stress and change, supporting regulation and grounding.
- Parts work: exploring the different parts of yourself with curiosity and compassion.
- Mindfulness-based practice: developing awareness of thoughts and reactivity, creating space and choice.

## How to start

The first step is a free 15-minute discovery call — a relaxed, no-obligation conversation to share what brings you here and see whether working together feels right. Enquiries are made through the contact page: https://theresafrische.com/contact

## What counselling is — and is not

This is a counselling (Beratung) practice. Counselling is not psychotherapy, medical treatment, or a substitute for either, and it does not involve diagnosis or medical care. Where a clinical matter needs assessment, that is the work of a licensed psychotherapist or doctor. If you are in crisis or need urgent support, please contact your local emergency services or a crisis line:

- Emergency (EU): 112
- Telefonseelsorge (Germany, free, 24h): 0800 111 0 111 / 0800 111 0 222
- Die Dargebotene Hand (Switzerland): 143
- International directory: https://findahelpline.com
